value.rationale: At fixed time the dilute system looks Poissonian in variance, while the known infinite-window limit is not Poissonian. The full Fano function quantifies when repeated collisions become visible, with the natural mixing scale, a sharp square-root onset, and the reciprocal-time approach to the late-time benchmark. This resolves a motivated connection between two distinct limits and is not just a recomputation of the long-time cumulant.
